_comment: Display Template preset: a request editor. See ../../codebot/display_template.md#display-presets. Copy this file's 'rules' array into your project's display.json (../../reference/presentation.md#display-template-file) and rename every placeholder below to your own schema names, then remove this and the '_placeholders' member.

_placeholders.Type: The Request variant, or configuration function, whose editor this is: '^<Type>' in every selector below.
_placeholders.group: A direct field of Type holding a long, mostly optional group of fields, declared as its own Table type: '^<Type>.group' selects that field.
_placeholders.category: An Enumeration or Union field of Type with four or fewer choices, shown inline instead of a chooser.
